scripts.compile:webview: npm run compile:webview:chart && npm run compile:webview:results && npm run compile:webview:plugins && npm run compile:webview:profiler && npm run compile:webview:workers
scripts.check: tsc -p ./ --noEmit && tsc -p webview/chart/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p webview/results/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p webview/plugins/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p webview/profiler/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p webview/workers/tsconfig.json --noEmit

notes.merge: Replace the axis.workers TreeView entry in contributes.views.axis with this webview (same id, type webview, icon media/views/workers.svg, retainContextWhenHidden true). Keep command axis.workers.probeAll and its view/title menu. Add compile:webview:workers and include it in compile:webview + check. Nest the vscodeignore whitelist like profiler. Add views/workers-panel.ts to EXCLUDE in scripts/check-coverage.mjs (workers.ts stays excluded). Do not edit this fragment into package.json from the workers studio agent. src/test/extension.test.ts must then expect axis.workers type webview and retainContextWhenHidden true.
notes.wiring: Call registerWorkersStudio(context) from registerPluginsAndWorkers (or activate). Pass registerWorkersTreeView(context, { tree: false }) so probe commands keep a provider without createTreeView — a tree and a webview cannot share axis.workers. Keep commands.registerCommand('axis.workers.probeAll', ...). After runProbeAllCommand, call studio.postSnapshot(snap) so the palette probe updates the webview. Webview buttons call probeWorker / probeAllWorkers themselves. registerWebviewViewProvider('axis.workers', provider, { webviewOptions: { retainContextWhenHidden: true } }).
notes.assets: Webview loads dist/webview/workers/main.js + main.css (Vite IIFE AxisWorkersWebview, clone of profiler).
notes.protocol: Host posts workers.init and workers.state { cards, counts, probed }. Web posts workers.ready, workers.probeAll, workers.probe { id }. Cards are { id, name, summary, probe, endpoint, status, latencyMs, detail }. Endpoint is host only. detail is a short error label — never a response body, token, or secret. Unknown before the first probe is status unknown, probed false.
notes.secrets: Do not print secrets, tokens, or response bodies in the webview.
